description: Caller claims to be the bank and a police inspector from a normal 10-digit mobile (98765 43210), not a TRAI 140 or 160 number. Unknown call, payment app, new payee and a large amount sit just under a pause; the +10 personal-mobile rule is what crosses it. Same script as normal-official-160-series-call.

events.text: I am calling from your bank. I am inspector Sharma. Your account will be blocked. This is urgent.
events.speaker: caller
